text:
All five messages are handled.

1. E1-1 and E1-2 (Exposition desk) are relayed to chat-f75aee1587 in one condensed message, close to the size limit. E1-3 cannot also fit, so it goes to the same lane next cycle. Swarm smwh405l7 is running, so start_successor=false.
   - I added one correction. The four cone modules passed in our local Lean queue. The lane read failing logs in its remote tree, but those logs are not evidence about our local runs.
   - Also, ASTRA-MC120-ENDPOINT-A5.txt exists only on this machine, so the lane will not find it in its tree.
2. R1-1 (Results desk) is relayed to chat-0a863015ff. Its swarm smwh3mq7r already covers the core recounts, so I sent the new parts as verdict-stage requirements and successor scope:
   - the propagation_incomplete count and the split between empty-side failures and cyclic-only failures;
   - explicit definitions of both cell systems in (d) and a verdict on each wording;
   - the explicit pair in (e);
   - the JSON schema.
3. Backslash: agreed, the stray first line was in the lane's source file, not in staging. The architecture lane had already fixed it and reported:
   - first line now the doc comment, 147 lines;
   - new sha256 884ed9bca9df9f0c32290ea529f74f06f66abc9c5fe2be8fa864476171c176a5;
   - root cause: a generator string literal.
   No message to that healthy lane. I staged a re-download of both CyclicCoreConsumerFromV2.lean and FiveSupport-swap.lean. Once you confirm the CyclicCore sha, I will review both and queue them against template claude-lean-20261114t232057-0.
4. The geometry lane (chat-b9bfdf6c4a) swarm smwh11xw7 has ended (solved, all members stopped). I sent a successor with start_successor=true and a 10/250/180 sizing. The task is an exact contact table for the q4/q5 list regions. This complements L-N4's certificate search and does not duplicate it.
5. No Lean proposals this cycle. The queue is idle, but no reviewed inbox .lean is available. The last job, 001551-0, was the backslash file and is superseded.

The other 13 lanes have healthy running swarms; no messages were sent to them.
summary:
